Anne Mette Falstie-Jensen is an epidemiologist holding a Ph.D., working at [[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]] (RKKP) [^src1]. She serves as a member of the steering committee for DANIBD (The Danish Registry for Inflammatory Bowel Disease), a role that underscores the scientific and data-driven foundation for quality measurement within the national IBD registry [^src1]. 

As part of the steering committee, she helps act as the strategic governing unit for a broader national effort to systematize and improve IBD treatment in Denmark [^src1]. This initiative relies on cross-regional quality measurement, standardized coding, and the evidence-based development of treatment guidelines, utilizing detailed quality data—such as the registry's clinical benchmarking metrics from October 1, 2022, to September 30, 2023—to evaluate treatment access and implement quality indicators [^src1].
